notifications.empty_all: You're all caught up. Hot leads and reminders will show here.

post_history.title: Posts
post_history.empty_body: Publish a post from Quick Post and it'll show up here with engagement metrics from Meta.
post_history.no_metrics: No metrics yet — tap Refresh to fetch
post_history.linkedin_note: LinkedIn analytics aren't available via the API. Tap View on LinkedIn for engagement.

scheduled.title: Scheduled posts
scheduled.empty_body: Open Quick Post → toggle Schedule → pick a time. Your scheduled drafts will show here.

sections.failed_subtitle: Permanent errors. Reconnect or try a new post.

alert.cancel_body: Cancel this {{platform}} post scheduled for {{when}}? This cannot be undone.

recurring.title: Recurring posts
recurring.empty_body: Open Quick Post → toggle Recurring → pick a cadence. Your recurrences will live here.

alert.cancel_body: Cancel this recurring post? This is permanent — agent will need to create a new recurrence to start over.

tasks.emptySubtitle: Create a task from a lead to see it here.
tasks.upcomingHint: No date or future due dates

briefings.onceYourMorningAndEvening: Once your morning and evening briefings have fired a few times, this is where you'll find them.

cma.noComparableSalesFoundIn: No comparable sales found in the area. Import MLS data to populate comps for accurate pricing.

coaching.dailyPlansWeeklyPlaybooksMonthly: Daily plans, weekly playbooks, monthly reviews — tied to a real annual transaction target.
coaching.coachingIsnTAvailableOn: Coaching isn't available on your current plan
coaching.coachingProgramsProducerTrackAnd: Coaching programs (Producer Track and Top Producer Track) aren't included in your current access.
coaching.producerTrackAutoEnrollsOn: Producer Track auto-enrolls on Pro and above; Top Producer Track is bundled with Premium, Signature and Team. Upgrade to start hitting 10–15 transactions a year with daily AI-driven plans.

meta.subtitle: One connection covers your Facebook Page and its Instagram account.
meta.details: Access tokens are stored encrypted, and you can disconnect any time. To revoke on Facebook's side as well, remove CloseBoss under your Facebook account's Apps and Websites.

li.subtitle: Post to your personal LinkedIn feed.
li.details: Posts go to your personal LinkedIn feed. To revoke on LinkedIn's side, go to Settings → Data privacy → Permitted services and remove CloseBoss.

tt.subtitle: Publish videos to your TikTok.
tt.details: Videos post to your connected TikTok account. Until TikTok approves the app for public posting, it can only post to a private account.

yt.subtitle: Upload Shorts and videos to your YouTube channel.
yt.details: Uploads go to your connected YouTube channel. To revoke on Google's side, open your Google Account → Security → Third-party access.

digitalTwin.recordAShortIntroVideo: Record a short intro video (talk to camera — who you are, your market, what you specialize in). AI turns it into your brand profile, used across your posts and assistants. Your video stays private.
digitalTwin.notAvailableYetServerNeeds: Not available yet (server needs FAL_KEY + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
digitalTwin.iConsentToAiUse: I consent to AI use of
digitalTwin.voiceCloningAndTalkingAvatar: Voice cloning and talking-avatar videos are on the dashboard. Re-record above anytime to refresh your profile.

expenses.logYourFirstBusinessCost: Log your first business cost above.
expenses.attachAPhotoOfThe: Attach a photo of the receipt for your records.

weeklySchedule.pickTheDaysYouWant: Pick the days you want a post. For each, choose a content type, time, channels, and a topic — or let AI pick the time and topic — and how many posts that day. AI researches the topic and posts automatically. Text → Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads. Image adds a branded card + Instagram & Pinterest. Video films your digital twin → TikTok, YouTube & more.
weeklySchedule.videoUsesYourDigitalTwin: Video uses your digital twin — set up your intro video + cloned voice first, or this day won't post.
weeklySchedule.aiSearchesTheWebFor: AI searches the web for what is timely and useful that day and writes about that.

offerDesk.pickAListingToCompare: Pick a listing to compare its offers
offerDesk.noListingsWithOffersYet: No listings with offers yet. Offers forwarded in by email show up here automatically once they match one of your listings.
offerDesk.howBadlyDoTheyWant: How badly do they want it? Anything special?
offerDesk.pasteThePurchaseContractText: Paste the purchase contract text here…
